action.objective: Commit Rc7+, the verified exact top move, keeping the rook active with check while maintaining the R+B vs R edge.
action.rationale: Rc7+ is the only commit_ready move: verified at depth 4 (exact 444), complete safety check with no mating reply and no tactical refutation found. It gives check, forcing Black's king back, and keeps the rook on an active square where it controls both the c-file and the 7th rank. Rf8 (515) was only depth 3 and bounded, not verified single-candidate, so it cannot be preferred. Rc7 preserves the material edge R+B+2P vs R+2P.
